resolution.note: ship awaits any run listed for the head that is not completed; test on a verbatim gh run list capture with status varied; fast PASS

title: Ship keeps waiting while the head Check run is queued
body:
Source: 2026-11-17 ship of t-r53fan0 exited 69 "the Check never started on 3a71b7d within 300s"; run 44035472255 on that SHA started later and passed, while three other PR runs queued.
Outcome: krn pr ship keeps waiting while the Check run for the head SHA is queued (or a run for it exists), and exits 69 only when no run for the SHA exists after the start window.
Proof: a ship test with a captured `gh run list` reply showing a queued run for the head asserts no exit 69.
Files: src/ci/ship.ts
